## File: google-deepmind_acme/examples/multiagent/multigrid/helpers.py

Prompts

```
['build a module that preprocesses multigrid observations with conv filters and one-hot direction encoding', 'create a DQN feed-forward network for a multigrid environment using an MLP with 50-unit hidden layers', 'create PPO actor-critic networks for a multigrid environment with configurable hidden layer sizes', 'build PPO networks with categorical policy sampling, log probability, and entropy from a feed-forward network', 'initialize default PPO networks for a multigrid environment given an agent type and environment spec', 'run a multiagent multigrid training experiment with PPO agents in distributed or single-threaded mode', 'build an experiment config for multigrid multiagent training with configurable PPO agent settings', 'create a factory function that produces a multigrid environment from a given environment name', 'create a network factory for multiagent networks using decentralized PPO agents and multigrid helpers', 'run a distributed multiagent experiment with 4 actors using LaunchPad and Docker resources']
```

Usage

```
{'build_multigrid_obs_preproc': 'build a module that preprocesses multigrid observations with conv filters and one-hot direction encoding', 'create_multigrid_dqn_networks': 'create a DQN feed-forward network for a multigrid environment using an MLP with 50-unit hidden layers', 'create_multigrid_ppo_networks': 'create PPO actor-critic networks for a multigrid environment with configurable hidden layer sizes', 'build_categorical_ppo_networks': 'build PPO networks with categorical policy sampling, log probability, and entropy from a feed-forward network', 'init_default_multigrid_network': 'initialize default PPO networks for a multigrid environment given an agent type and environment spec'}
```
